status: SOURCE-BOUND RESEARCH SCREENS / NO RECOMMENDED FASTENER TORQUE / CNC HOLD

sources.nasa_torque_section: Appendix A.2, p.46, Eq.24: Ppi-nom=T/(Knom*D), with explicit preload variation; SPACEFLIGHT standard only cited as physics/research reference, NOT binding audio cabinet requirements.

research_model.note: 151.11 N in P40A is resultant sqrt(119.92^2+91.94^2), NOT axial compression. No actual plate contact pressure or joint preload is measured.
research_model.rectangular_rigid_plate_one_dimensional_: Assume pressure is linear along radial axis; contact may not sustain tension; screw force at radial axis; width constant; no material compliance, holes, retainer screw stiffness, head or flange preload included.

torque_probes.warning: Scenario only, K not measured, torque NOT prescribed. These computed preloads can dominate 119.92N P40 external axial demand. Do not tighten prototype to arbitrary K14 torque without testing.

tolerance_probe.label: Synthetic independent two-sided dimensional stress intervals, NOT actual manufacturer tolerances

pocket_tolerance_probe.label: Synthetic pad-inner-edge vs pocket-inner-edge relative offsets in opposite directions, not documented cutter or substrate tolerances
pocket_tolerance_probe.note: Worst pocket inner-wall thickness 0.5−2δ and steel edge web 2.1−2δ for independent adverse shifts of equal magnitude δ.

coaxiality_screen.label: Independent registration error in x/z from bolt axis; conservative guaranteed through clearance is half of (Ø5.5−Ø5.0)=0.25 mm.
coaxiality_screen.caution: Not actual capability of a machining process. Real threaded axis, flange basket and screw straightness are unmeasured.
